question: An air traffic controller needs to control the landing times of n aircrafts: Flights must land in the order 1, ..., n. Flight j must land in time interval [aj , bj ]. n = 10. [a1, b1] = [0, 60], [a2, b2] = [10, 70], [a3, b3] = [20,80], [a4, b4] = [30, 90], [a5, b5] = [40, 100], [a6, b6] = [50, 110], [a7, b7] = [60, 120], [a8, b8] = [70, 130], [a9, b9] = [80, 140], [a10, b10] = [90, 150]. The objective is to maximize the minimum separation time, which is the interval between two landings. Find the maximal minimum separation. Provide your answer rounded to the nearest time.

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(expr=model.separation, sense=pyo.maximize)

import pyomo.environ as pyo

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Problem data
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Flights must land in the order 1, 2, ..., n.
# Flight j must land in the time window [a_j, b_j].
# Objective: maximise the minimum separation between consecutive landings.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
DATA = {
    "n": 10,
    "a": {1: 0,  2: 10, 3: 20, 4: 30, 5: 40,
          6: 50, 7: 60, 8: 70, 9: 80, 10: 90},
    "b": {1: 60, 2: 70, 3: 80, 4: 90, 5: 100,
          6: 110, 7: 120, 8: 130, 9: 140, 10: 150},
    # Big-M for the separation variable: an upper bound on any feasible
    # separation.  The whole horizon spans at most b_n - a_1 = 150.
    "M": 150,
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Decision variables
#   t[j]  : landing time of flight j, continuous, bounded by [a_j, b_j]
#   s     : the minimum separation between consecutive landings (>= 0)
#
# Objective (maximise):
#   maximise s
#
# Constraints:
#   (1) a_j <= t[j] <= b_j                       for every flight j
#   (2) t[j+1] - t[j] >= s                       for j = 1..n-1
#       (each consecutive gap is at least the minimum separation)
#   (3) s <= M                                   (bounding the objective)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    n = d["n"]
    a = d["a"]
    b = d["b"]
    M = d["M"]

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # Index set of flights
    model.J = pyo.RangeSet(1, n)
    # Index set of consecutive pairs
    model.P = pyo.RangeSet(1, n - 1)

    # Landing times, bounded by the allowed windows
    def t_bounds(m, j):
        return (a[j], b[j])

    model.t = pyo.Var(model.J, domain=pyo.Reals, bounds=t_bounds)

    # Minimum separation variable
    model.s = pyo.Var(domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=(0, M))

    # (2) consecutive separation constraints
    def sep_rule(m, j):
        return m.t[j + 1] - m.t[j] >= m.s

    model.sep = pyo.Constraint(model.P, rule=sep_rule)

    # Objective: maximise the minimum separation
    def obj_rule(m):
        return m.s

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    return model
